1. Initialize capsule:
   printf "%s" "$PROMPT" | bun ~/.agents/skills/orchestrating-long-tasks/scripts/harness.ts plan:init --repo /Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/gvui --run 2026-08-14-gvui-advanced-observability-v2 --prompt-stdin --capture-mode stdin --source-verified
2. Register tasks:
   - T-01: "Types & Pure JSON Data Contracts", scope src/types, gate bun test src/types
   - T-02: "GVUI Dynamic Canvas Measurer & Height Sizing", scope src/engine/layout/measurement, gate bun test src/engine/layout/measurement
   - T-03: "GVUI Node Archetypes & Color Harmony", scope src/primitives/nodes/NodeCard, deps T-01,T-02, gate bun test src/primitives/nodes/NodeCard
   - T-04: "GVUI Rich Edge Containers & Semantic Styles", scope src/primitives/edges, deps T-01,T-02, gate bun test src/primitives/edges
   - T-05: "GVUI Merged Overview & I/O Tab with Expandable Streams", scope src/components/NodeDetailDrawer, deps T-01,T-02, gate bun test src/components/NodeDetailDrawer
   - T-06: "E2E Integration, Full WASM Layout Validation & Manifest Registration", scope public/data/graphs, deps T-03,T-04,T-05, gate bun test src
3. Compile plan:
   bun ~/.agents/skills/orchestrating-long-tasks/scripts/harness.ts plan:compile --run /Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/gvui/.capsules/2026-08-14-gvui-advanced-observability-v2 --actor coordinator
4. Execute Wave 0, Wave 1, and Wave 2 tasks:
   - Dispatch Tier 3 implementers and independent Tier 3 validators.
   - Validators MUST perform Adversarial Invariant Audits:
     - Monitored gate command execution (run:exec).
     - Invariant checking (data contracts, visual color matching, dynamic height calculations, collision avoidance, merged Overview & I/O tab, unclipped stream accordions with byte/token metrics).
     - Exercise formal pushbacks where appropriate (task:reject --run ... --task ... --validator ... --token ... --reason "..." --finding "...") and verify remediation in Round 2 before issuing task:review --status pass.

5. Whole-run completion:
   - bun ~/.agents/skills/orchestrating-long-tasks/scripts/harness.ts run:exec --run /Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/gvui/.capsules/2026-08-14-gvui-advanced-observability-v2 --gate gate-run-completion --actor coordinator -- bun test src
   - critic:start and critic:review with complete requirement audit.
   - run:complete to seal the capsule.
   - Re-export the final capsule summary so public/data/graphs/2026-08-14-gvui-advanced-observability-v2.json contains the completed run state.
6. When 100% complete, send one final comprehensive summary to the parent thread with the complete execution ledger, exact validator pushback counts, and proof of WASM layout validation.
